mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SEARCH_AD_SHOPPING ( ncc_ad_id, ad_name, use_yn, target_position, min_bid, max_bid, memo, regist_dt, modify_dt, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{nccAdId}, #{adName}, IFNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{targetPosition}, #{minBid}, #{maxBid}, #{memo}, NOW(), NOW(), 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SEARCH_AD_SHOPPING SET ncc_ad_id = #{nccAdId}, ad_name = #{adName}, use_yn = IFNULL(#{useYn}, use_yn), target_position = #{targetPosition}, min_bid = #{minBid}, max_bid = #{maxBid}, memo = #{memo}, modify_dt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_yn = 'N'
UPDATE TB_SEARCH_AD_SHOPPING SET del_yn = 'Y', modify_dt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
